summary_1line: After Rama’s victory and coronation, sages from all directions visit his palace, honor him, and praise his defeat of Ravana and other demons.

image_candidates.scene_text: A gathering of radiant sages from the four directions stands at the gates of Rama’s palace while Agastya speaks to the royal doorkeeper.
Rama rises from his throne and respectfully offers water and gifts to the assembled sages seated on gold‑inlaid seats covered with kusa grass and antelope skins.
The sages, glowing like sacred fire, praise Rama in the royal hall while he stands with folded palms beside Sita and Lakshmana.
